trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE p.current_team = t.team_name AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, p.name AS col3, p.current_team AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
